options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Skull Sanity
options.doc:
Adds skull disabler items to the item pool. All included skulls are forced
on at game start; receiving a "Disable X" item lets you toggle that skull off.

off:         No skull items or logic.
non_scoring: non scoring skulls are locked off, reciving the item for them lets you turn them on.
all: All skulls are locked, scoring skulls are locked on and non scoring skulls are locked off. reciving the item for them lets you toggle them.
inverted: all skulls are locked off, reciving the item for them lets you turn them on.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute des éléments de désactivation du crâne à la piscine d'éléments. Tous les crânes inclus sont forcés au début du jeu; recevoir un élément "Disable X" vous permet de basculer ce crâne.

hors: Pas d'éléments de crâne ou de logique.
non scoring: les crânes non marqués sont verrouillés, en réactivant l'élément pour eux vous permet de les activer.
Tous les crânes sont verrouillés, les crânes marqués sont verrouillés et les crânes non marqués sont verrouillés. Recevoir l'élément pour eux vous permet de les basculer.
inversement: tous les crânes sont verrouillés, en réactivant l'objet pour eux vous permet de les allumer.
